Vision To Empower the common youth by incorporating skills into them to achieve their peak potential & serve the Nation. Mission We are on a mission to place 1 million aspirants into IT companies by 2030. Motto Join us to be a Technology Expert. Start Now Welcome to 3RI Technologies 3RI Technologies is a leading IT training provider, driven by a mission to bridge the skills gap between academia and industry. Our training is led by experienced professionals with 8-10 years in the field, ensuring candidates gain practical knowledge and workplace readiness. We specialize in hands-on learning with real-time projects and personalized placement support, equipping learners to excel in their careers. Recognizing the evolving demands of the global technology landscape, we’ve developed a progressive education framework focused on industry requirements. At 3RI , we believe in targeted, impactful learning-offering a wide range of short-term, industry-specific certification programs designed to meet the diverse career needs of our students. Our goal is to create a robust knowledge hub that empowers individuals to thrive in their chosen domains. 3RI stands for : Respect: for knowledge, resources, and associates. Rational: approach to concepts, behavior, and principles. Response: to opportunities, requirements, and change. Innovative: solutions for customer satisfaction. Riitesh Sharma Founder & Director, 3RI Technologies Riitesh Sharma , the visionary Founder and Director of 3RI Technologies, is dedicated to bridging the gap between industry needs and talent through innovative IT training. With years of experience in cutting-edge technologies, he has positioned 3RI Technologies as a leader in professional education, offering industry-relevant courses in Data Science, Cloud Computing, Full Stack Development, and more. Under his guidance, 3RI has partnered with global leaders like AWS and IIT Guwahati, delivering job-ready skills and fostering a culture of lifelong learning. Riitesh’s mission is to make IT education accessible and transformative, empowering individuals and organizations to excel in the ever-evolving tech landscape. Rupali Sharma Founder & Technical Director, 3RI Technologies Rupali Sharma , MS from BITS Pilani, is the Founder and Technical Director of 3RI Technologies. With deep expertise in cutting-edge technologies, market trends, and industry expectations, she drives the company’s technical vision. Her exceptional technical acumen and strategic insights ensure 3RI stays ahead in delivering industry-relevant training. Rupali’s leadership and dedication inspire the team to empower learners with skills for the ever-evolving IT landscape. Neha Syed Director – Leadership, Brand & Strategic Alliances Neha Syed drives leadership development, brand alignment, and strategic alliances at 3RI Technologies. She works closely with the leadership team to strengthen execution culture, ethical practices, and long-term growth initiatives. Through business coaching and strategic engagement, she represents 3RI across professional and industry forums. Kavita Paliwal Assistant Manager, 3RI Technologies Kavita Paliwal , is the driving force behind seamless operations, ensuring top-notch training and student support. With her dedication and problem-solving skills, she keeps everything on track, making learning smooth and impactful. She believes 3RI is not just about training but transforming careers, empowering students to step confidently into the IT industry. Madan Thorat CMO, 3RI Technologies Madan Thorat , our CMO, is a sharpshooter in the world of on-page SEO and digital marketing. The driving force behind our online presence and marketing channels, he ensures precision and quality in every task. Our Trainers & Staff A 3RI Team is a group of Industry professionals having a passion for delivering knowledge to aspirants. We stand apart from our competitors because our staff members come from within your industry. They have years of experience and committed to improve your knowledge and solve workspace issues. They are dedicated to improving themselves on current technologies that are sought within the industry. Empowering Careers, Transforming Futures 3RI Technologies emphasize on Quality training and offer Placement assistance. We have a dedicated Placement Team for our Students Placement Assistance. We have placed 10,000+ candidates in various technologies. We train you as per company requirements and Job profile. We guide you in forming a resume; arrange a mock interview, which is a simulation of actual Job Interviews with our experts. Our mock interview helps you to understand interview strategies and helps you to crack actual Job Interviews. We frequently arrange training on Communication Skills, Aptitude, and Group Discussion to increase Students Employability.
